prompt.alinti: Claude can now turn your report into an animated video.
It's called Claude Motion, and it's in beta now.
In the message box, pick motion, describe the video, and attach your charts or images.
There's no video model behind it.
Claude writes every animation as code, so you can change any word, number, or timing,
then export it as an MP4.
This used to take hours in a timeline editor.
It's on team and enterprise plans, and on by default for team.
Comment 'MOTION' and I'll DM you the link and a quick how-to.
